closures.detail:
Closes game fish angling in Stevens Creek.
Closed to fishing. Reason for actions: Humptulips Salmon Hatchery broodstock goals have not been met in three of the last four years, and the pre-season hatchery return forecast is less than half of the recent average. Chinook stage in Stevens Creek before entering the hatchery. Current low flows are hindering their ability to access the hatchery intake, leaving them vulnerable to fishing pressure. This closure is necessary to improve chances of meeting hatchery broodstock goals by reducing impacts on Chinook staging to enter the hatchery.
